## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The refresh helper should preserve existing fingerprints because overwriting them hides edits to tracked files. This review read both changed files and the tests; tests were not run.

## Changes
The pull request adds helpers to refresh the fingerprint manifest and register previously unlisted files, plus tests for both helpers.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/integrity.py:17 — correctness — Preserve existing fingerprints during refresh — If `tracked.txt` has been edited and you pass it alongside `new.txt` to `refresh_fingerprints`, the helper replaces its original digest and `verify` returns true despite the edit. The unconditional assignment overwrites the evidence needed to detect that modification, contrary to the pull-request description. — Refreshing the manifest after adding files can conceal changes to previously tracked content. — Fix: Preserve entries already present in the manifest, as `register_new_files` does, and add a regression test using an edited tracked file.
